items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: I had one, Bobby Green, he played real well... So, he got in, he played a little, the bebop style... Bobby Green, alto and tenor sax... That was a beautiful session.

ctx.x: And then that, cause, I had one, Bobby Green, he played real well. He could play bebop good. You know? So, he got in, he played a little, the bebop style. Then,
I put a couple of beebop tunes in my book and (inaudible) arranged it cause beebop was kind of coming in style then cause Dizzy was exploring that. You know?
